description: Land Acquisition - Lands in Ahugoda, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District - acquisition for the Central Expressway
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired by the State for public purpose. It contains land descriptions, lot numbers, extents, land use details, and claimant information, along with procedures for compensation claims. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined for Type 4 classification.
